test_title: PYST 51: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 01 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Brianna is sitting second to the right of Mark. Felix is sitting second to the left of Mark. Ann is the immediate neighbour of Brianna and Felix. James is sitting third to the left of Brianna. Afreen is sitting second to the right of James. Who is sitting between Afreen and Ann?
solution: **Given :** Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. **Explanation : ** 1) Brianna is sitting second to the right of Mark. 2) James is sitting third to the left of Brianna. 3) Afreen is sitting second to the right of James.
